task: Regression — predicts composite facility readiness score (0–1)
known_limitations: Only 100 training samples — prone to overfitting
Readiness score target was pre-computed, not derived from independent outcome data
Does not account for supply chain seasonality or stockout frequency
Trained on synthetic data — must be recalibrated with real MFL data
intended_use: Predicting facility readiness to identify under-resourced facilities for intervention prioritization.
review_status: Pre-production — pending validation with real data
